_about: Researched headlines for the History tab. Written in our own words, each checked against the linked source. Add more seasons the same way; the page fills the rest of the top 5 from the results data.

2025.title: Norris wins the title by 2 points
2025.text: Lando Norris beat Max Verstappen by two points, sealing it with third place in the Abu Dhabi finale.

2025.title: Both McLarens disqualified in Las Vegas
2025.text: Norris (2nd) and Piastri (4th) were thrown out after their cars' skid blocks wore below the legal minimum, pulling Verstappen level with Piastri in the standings.

2024.title: Hamilton announces a move to Ferrari
2024.text: Early in 2024, Lewis Hamilton confirmed he would leave Mercedes for Ferrari in 2025, a subplot that ran all season.

2024.title: McLaren's first constructors' title since 1998
2024.text: Norris won the Abu Dhabi finale to seal McLaren's first teams' championship in 26 years.

2023.title: Verstappen wins 19 of 22
2023.text: A record 19 wins, including 10 in a row, while Red Bull won every race but Singapore.

2022.title: Red Bull fined for breaking the budget cap
2022.text: The FIA fined Red Bull $7 million and cut its wind tunnel time after finding it overspent the 2021 cost cap.

2021.title: The Abu Dhabi final-lap controversy
2021.text: A late safety car restart let Verstappen, on fresh tyres, pass Hamilton on the last lap. The FIA later blamed human error but let the result stand, and race director Michael Masi was replaced.

2020.title: Grosjean walks out of a fireball
2020.text: Romain Grosjean's car split in two and caught fire on lap 1 in Bahrain. He climbed out after 10 to 15 seconds in the flames with minor burns, and drivers credited the halo.

2019.title: Chaos in the rain at Hockenheim
2019.text: Verstappen won a wet German GP where Hamilton crashed from the lead, Vettel climbed from last to 2nd, and Kvyat put Toro Rosso on the podium.

2018.title: Hamilton matches Fangio's five titles
2018.text: Fourth place in Mexico was enough for Lewis Hamilton's fifth championship, level with Juan Manuel Fangio.

2017.title: Vettel's Baku road rage
2017.text: Behind the safety car, Vettel ran into the back of leader Hamilton, then pulled alongside and banged wheels. He got a 10-second stop-go penalty.

2016.title: Champion Rosberg retires five days later
2016.text: Nico Rosberg won his first title and then quit F1 less than a week afterward.

2016.title: Verstappen wins on his Red Bull debut, aged 18
2016.text: The Mercedes pair took each other out on lap 1 in Spain, and Verstappen became F1's youngest winner in his first race for Red Bull.

2015.title: A 17-year-old scores points
2015.text: Max Verstappen finished 7th in Malaysia at 17 years and 180 days, F1's youngest ever points scorer.
